name: io.github.mspstack/mcp-itglue
title: IT Glue
description: IT Glue MCP server for MSPs — documents, flexible assets, semantic vector search, RBAC, and BYOK

environmentVariables.name: ITGLUE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: IT Glue API key (Account → Settings → API Keys)

environmentVariables.name: ITGLUE_REGION
environmentVariables.description: IT Glue region: us, eu, or au

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key — enables semantic vector search tools

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Azure OpenAI API key — enables vector search via Azure (requires AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT)

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model or Azure deployment name

environmentVariables.name: ITGLUE_ADVANCED_TOOLSET
environmentVariables.description: true/1 registers the advanced toolset (itglue_get, itglue_find_endpoint) — an opt-in read-only escape hatch; password resources stay blocked

environmentVariables.name: VECTOR_INDEX_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path of the persisted vector index file

environmentVariables.name: UPLOAD_STAGING
environmentVariables.description: Staged file uploads for upload_id: off, memory (PUT to this server's /upload/:id), or azure-blob (SAS upload to Azure Blob Storage). Default: memory on http, off on stdio

environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Externally reachable base URL of this server, used for memory-mode upload URLs

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING
environmentVariables.description: azure-blob staging: storage account connection string (account-key SAS)

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: azure-blob staging via DefaultAzureCredential (managed identity) — alternative to the connection string
